description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Revocation of Order made to appoint Mr. M. Ariff and appointed Mr. K. M. Sarathchandra as the arbitrator for settlement of the Industrial Dispute between Mr. D. K. Shantha Senaratne and National Housing Development Authority - Appointed Mr. Suneth Lokubogahawatta as the arbitrator for the settlement of the Industrial Dispute between Mr. M. Gunapala and Ceylon Electricity Board - Revocation of Order made to appoint Mr. Suneth Lokubogahawatta and appointed Mr. S. Virithamulla as the arbitrator for settlement of the Industrial Dispute between Mr. D. H. Pathirane and Taprobane Studios Ranch (Private) Ltd. - Appointed Mr. S. Kariyawasam as the arbitrator for settlement of Industrial Dispute between Mr. I. Nimal Ranatunga and Sri Lanka Transport Board (S  E only)
